## Tab.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The value this tab represents, paired with its `TabPanel`.
- `disabled` :: Prevents the tab from being selected.
- `gap` :: The space between a tab's icon and its label. @default 'gap-sm'
- `alignContent` :: How a tab's content sits along the row. @default 'xcenter'
- `children` :: The tab label.

## TabList.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `label` :: Accessible name of the tab list, when there is no visible label.
- `children` :: The tab buttons of this list, in the order they should be read.

## TabPanel.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The value of the `Tab` this panel belongs to.
- `pad` :: The inset inside the panel. @default 'pad-md'
- `children` :: The panel content.

## Tabs.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The selected tab's value. Two-way bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called whenever the selected tab changes.
- `orientation` :: Lays the tab list out in a row or a column.
- `activation` :: `automatic` selects a tab when it receives focus; `manual` waits for Enter or Space.
- `grouping` :: How the tabs sit together: `flush` underlines the active tab, `separated` puts a gap between pills, `contained` wraps them in one panel.
- `surface` :: The surface the contained list is drawn on; only `contained` reads it, and the indicator borrows the same recipe.
- `size` :: The control height and text scale of each tab.
- `textColor` :: The ink of a tab that is not selected.
- `gap` :: The space between the tab list and the panels. @default 'gap-bs'
- `animated` :: Transitions panels in and out with a spring fade.
- `children` :: The `TabList` and `TabPanel`s.

## tabs.svelte.ts

### `type TabsActivation`

Whether arrow keys select a tab (`automatic`) or only move focus (`manual`).

### `interface TabsContext`

Shared state between Tabs, TabList, Tab and TabPanel.

- `uid` :: The group's unique id prefix, used to pair tabs with their panels.
- `value` :: The selected tab's value.
- `select` :: Select a tab.
- `orientation` :: List orientation.
- `activation` :: Keyboard activation mode.
- `size` :: Control height and text scale.
- `textColor` :: The ink of a tab that is not selected.
- `animated` :: Whether panels enter and leave with a spring fade.

- `grouping` :: How the tabs sit together: `flush` underlines the active tab, `separated` puts a gap between pills, `contained` wraps them in one panel.
- `surface` :: The surface the contained list is drawn on; only `contained` uses it, and the indicator borrows the same recipe.
